13.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_000
13.description: Your squadron is not currently deployed.
13.translation_description: La tua squadriglia non è al momento in missione.

14.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_010
14.description: Your squadron has already completed its current deployment.
14.translation_description: La tua squadriglia ha già completato la missione in corso.

15.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_020
15.description: Unable to accept mission report. Insufficient inventory or crystal space.
15.translation_description: Impossibile accettare il rapporto di missione: spazio insufficiente nell’inventario o per contenere i cristalli.

25.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_GUIDE_006
25.translation_description: Cambiare classe ai membri della squadriglia.

38.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_281
38.description: By completing categories in your challenge log you will occasionally attract new recruits to your squadron.
38.translation_description: Completando le categorie del Registro Sfide, potresti attirare di tanto in tanto nuove reclute nella tua squadriglia.

39.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_282
39.description: The appearance of potential recruits will be announced with an on-screen message, and their enlistment papers will be delivered to your desk inside the barracks.
39.translation_description: L’arrivo di potenziali reclute sarà annunciato con un messaggio sullo schermo, e troverai i loro moduli d’arruolamento sulla tua scrivania in caserma.

40.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_283
40.description: You can also check if recruits are available by opening the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> interface located under <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in the main menu.
40.translation_description: Puoi controllare se ci sono reclute disponibili anche nell’interfaccia <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, accessibile dal menu principale alla voce <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Incarichi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

41.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_284
41.description: Visit the barracks and read the enlistment papers to decide which recruits you wish to add to your squadron.
41.translation_description: Vai in caserma e leggi i moduli d’arruolamento per decidere quali reclute aggiungere alla tua squadriglia.

44.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_292
44.description: You can decide if you wish to add a new recruit to your squadron after selecting the respective enlistment form.
44.translation_description: Dopo aver selezionato il modulo d’arruolamento corrispondente, puoi decidere se aggiungere la recluta alla tua squadriglia.

45.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_100_292
45.description: Should your squadron roster already contain the maximum eight members, then you will need to discharge an existing member in order to enlist a new recruit.
45.translation_description: Se l’organico della tua squadriglia è già al completo, con otto membri, dovrai congedarne uno prima di arruolare una nuova recluta.

53.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_300
53.description: Squadron missions are duties that have been assigned to your adventurer recruits by the <hex:020812E1E93501FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF0103><hex:020820E1E93601FF184F72646572206F6620746865205477696E204164646572FF0103><hex:020818E1E93701FF10496D6D6F7274616C20466C616D6573FF0103>. To undertake a mission, you must select four squadron members for deployment.
53.translation_description: Le missioni della squadriglia sono incarichi affidati alle tue reclute avventuriere per conto <hex:020817E1E93501FF0F64656C6C612054656D7065737461FF0103><hex:02082BE1E93601FF2364656C6CE280994F7264696E652064656C6C61205669706572612047656D656C6C61FF0103><hex:02081FE1E93701FF1764656C6C65204669616D6D6520496D6D6F7274616C69FF0103>. Per intraprenderne una, devi schierare quattro membri della squadriglia.

54.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_301
54.description: Each mission requires that you pay your recruits a number of company seals and takes 18 hours (Earth time) to complete.
54.translation_description: Per ogni missione devi pagare una certa quantità di sigilli della Compagnia; il completamento richiede 18 ore (ora terrestre).

55.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_302
55.description: The time remaining until a mission is completed can be viewed by opening the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> interface located under <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in the main menu.
55.translation_description: Puoi vedere quanto manca al completamento della missione aprendo l’interfaccia <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, accessibile dal menu principale alla voce <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Incarichi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

56.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_303
56.description: Speak with your squadron sergeant to begin deployments and confirm mission results.
56.translation_description: Parla con il sergente della squadriglia per avviare le missioni e confermarne gli esiti.

57.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_304
57.description: Each duty can be completed once per week, with all mission timers and respective strength requirements being reset every <hex:020603120303><hex:020942DDFF0753756E646179FF074D6F6E646179FF0854756573646179FF0A5765646E6573646179FF095468757273646179FF07467269646179FF09536174757264617903> at <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (Earth time).
57.translation_description: Ogni incarico può essere completato una volta a settimana. I timer delle missioni e i relativi requisiti di forza si azzerano ogni <hex:020603120303><hex:020947DDFF09646F6D656E696361FF086C756E6564C3ACFF096D6172746564C3ACFF0B6D6572636F6C6564C3ACFF0967696F766564C3ACFF0976656E657264C3ACFF0773616261746F03> alle <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (ora terrestre).

68.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_312
68.description: Training courses will improve your squadron's attributes as a unit, providing increases to overall physical, mental, and tactical strength.
68.translation_description: I corsi di addestramento migliorano le caratteristiche della squadriglia nel suo insieme, aumentandone la forza fisica, mentale e tattica.

69.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_313
69.description: The focus on which squadron attribute is improved varies from course to course, so consider the values required for completing the more difficult missions when planning a regimen for your recruits.
69.translation_description: L’attributo della squadriglia migliorato varia da un corso all’altro. Quando pianifichi l’addestramento, considera i valori richiesti per completare le missioni più difficili.

70.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_314
70.description: Each training course takes 1 hour to complete (Earth time). The time remaining until a course is completed can be viewed by opening the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> interface located under <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in the main menu.
70.translation_description: Ogni corso di addestramento richiede un’ora (ora terrestre). Puoi controllare quanto manca al suo completamento aprendo l’interfaccia <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, accessibile dal menu principale alla voce <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Incarichi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

71.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_315
71.description: View the regimen board to commence courses and confirm the results of squadron training.
71.translation_description: Consulta il tabellone del programma di addestramento per iniziare i corsi e verificarne gli esiti.

72.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_316
72.description: You can order your squadron to train up to three times a day. This limit is reset every day at <hex:0206020603><hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (Earth time).
72.translation_description: Puoi ordinare alla tua squadriglia di allenarsi fino a tre volte al giorno. Il limite si azzera ogni giorno alle <hex:0206020603><hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (ora terrestre).

77.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_010_310
77.description: The total value of squadron attributes is subject to a maximum limit. Once this maximum has been reached, any attempt to raise a certain attribute will result in the reduction of another.
77.translation_description: Il valore totale degli attributi della squadriglia non può superare un limite massimo. Una volta raggiunto, aumentare un attributo ne farà diminuire un altro.

78.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_010_311
78.description: Maximum attribute values can be increased by improving your squadron rank, which is accomplished by successfully completing special missions.
78.translation_description: Puoi aumentare i valori massimi degli attributi migliorando il grado della squadriglia, che cresce completando con successo missioni speciali.

79.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_010_320
79.description: Changing the class of your squadron members requires you to first be in possession of the specific squadron-related item.
79.translation_description: Per cambiare classe a un membro della squadriglia, devi prima possedere l’apposito oggetto per la squadriglia.

80.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_010_321
80.description: Once you have the item required, check the regimen board and select the option to “View squadron roster.” Next, choose a squadron member, and use the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Change Class<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> subcommand to switch to the desired class.
80.translation_description: Dopo aver ottenuto l’oggetto necessario, consulta il tabellone del programma di addestramento e seleziona «Visualizza l’organico della squadriglia». Scegli un membro della squadriglia, poi usa il comando <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Change Class<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per assegnargli la classe desiderata.

83.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_010_330
83.description: Upon returning from a mission, a squadron member will occasionally exhibit a preference for a certain squadron composition.
83.translation_description: Al rientro da una missione, un membro della squadriglia può manifestare una preferenza per una determinata composizione della squadra.

84.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_010_331
84.description: This “squadron chemistry” can affect the outcome of missions by improving attributes or increasing rewards, and its bonuses will come into play when meeting certain requirements. Requirements vary, but generally involve deploying a squadron composed of a certain combination of classes or races.
84.translation_description: Questa «alchimia della squadriglia» può influire sull’esito delle missioni migliorando gli attributi o aumentando le ricompense. I bonus si attivano soddisfacendo determinati requisiti, che in genere riguardano una specifica combinazione di classi o razze nella squadriglia.

85.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_010_332
85.description: Chemistry settings are accessed via the regimen board by selecting “View squadron roster,” then using the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Confirm Chemistry<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> subcommand after choosing a squadron member.
85.translation_description: Per configurare l’alchimia, apri il tabellone del programma di addestramento, seleziona «Visualizza l’organico della squadriglia», scegli un membro e usa il comando <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Confirm Chemistry<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

86.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_010_333
86.description: Simply exhibiting a chemistry preference provides no bonuses. Should you deploy a squadron on their next mission without first activating any available chemistry options, the bonuses will disappear without effect.
86.translation_description: Avere una preferenza per l’alchimia non dà alcun bonus. Se schieri la squadriglia nella missione successiva senza aver prima attivato una delle opzioni di alchimia disponibili, i bonus scompariranno senza effetto.

87.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_010_340
87.description: The “Mission Affinity” window displays a random prerequisite for select missions. By deploying members of the suggested class or race, the effects of squadron chemistry will be amplified.
87.translation_description: La finestra «Affinità Missione» mostra un requisito casuale per alcune missioni. Schierando membri della classe o razza suggerita, potenzierai gli effetti dell’alchimia della squadriglia.

88.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_010_341
88.description: Meeting affinity prerequisites can also greatly improve your squadron's chances of completing the more difficult duties, so be sure to take this information into consideration when deciding which members to deploy.
88.translation_description: Soddisfare i requisiti di affinità può aumentare notevolmente le probabilità della squadriglia di completare gli incarichi più difficili. Tienine conto quando scegli chi schierare.

89.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_010_342
89.description: Affinity prerequisites are attached to all routine and priority missions, and are reset every <hex:020603120303><hex:020942DDFF0753756E646179FF074D6F6E646179FF0854756573646179FF0A5765646E6573646179FF095468757273646179FF07467269646179FF09536174757264617903> at <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (Earth time).
89.translation_description: Tutte le missioni ordinarie e prioritarie hanno requisiti di affinità, che si azzerano ogni <hex:020603120303><hex:020947DDFF09646F6D656E696361FF086C756E6564C3ACFF096D6172746564C3ACFF0B6D6572636F6C6564C3ACFF0967696F766564C3ACFF0976656E657264C3ACFF0773616261746F03> alle <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (ora terrestre).

102.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_340
102.description: Command missions are duties that put you at the head of a four-man unit─yourself and three soldiers─for a foray into an instanced dungeon.
102.translation_description: Le missioni di comando ti mettono a capo di un’unità di quattro persone—tu e tre soldati—per affrontare un spedizione in un’istanza dedicata.

103.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_341
103.description: The unit must comprise one tank, one healer, and two DPS.
103.translation_description: L’unità deve essere composta da un difensore, un curatore e due DPS.

104.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_342
104.description: While unit members have their own free will, responding as the situation demands, they can be given orders to guide their actions.
104.translation_description: I membri dell’unità agiscono di propria iniziativa in base alla situazione, ma puoi impartire loro ordini per guidarne le azioni.

105.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_343
105.description: There are three types of orders: Engage, Disengage, and Execute Limit Break. These can be issued via a dedicated hotbar.
105.translation_description: Ci sono tre tipi di ordini: Ingaggia, Disimpegnati ed Esegui Trascendenza. Puoi impartirli tramite una barra delle azioni dedicata.

106.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_344
106.description: Engage tells your unit to attack the targeted enemy.
106.translation_description: Ingaggia ordina ai membri dell’unità di attaccare il nemico selezionato.

107.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_345
107.description: Disengage tells your unit to break off combat and regroup near you.
107.translation_description: Disimpegnati ordina ai membri dell’unità di interrompere il combattimento e radunarsi vicino a te.

108.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_346
108.description: While Disengage is in effect, it will be replaced with the order Re-engage.
108.translation_description: Mentre Disimpegnati è attivo, al suo posto comparirà l’ordine Ingaggia di Nuovo.

109.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_347
109.description: The Disengage status can be lifted by issuing either the Engage or Re-engage order.
109.translation_description: Puoi annullare lo stato Disimpegnati impartendo l’ordine Ingaggia o Ingaggia di Nuovo.

110.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_348
110.description: Execute Limit Break tells your unit to perform a level 1 limit break.
110.translation_description: Esegui Trascendenza ordina alla tua unità di usare una Trascendenza di livello 1.

111.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_349
111.description: Even if the limit gauge is two bars full, only one bar will be consumed.
111.translation_description: Anche se la barra della Trascendenza è carica di due segmenti, ne consumerai uno solo.

112.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_350
112.description: Orders can also be set to your other hotbars by selecting them from the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Orders<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> interface found within <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Actions & Traits<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
112.translation_description: Puoi assegnare gli ordini anche alle altre barre delle azioni: selezionali nell’interfaccia <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Orders<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, disponibile in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Actions & Traits<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

113.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_351
113.description: Speak with your squadron sergeant to undertake command missions and confirm mission results.
113.translation_description: Parla con il sergente della squadriglia per intraprendere missioni di comando e confermarne gli esiti.

114.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_360
114.description: Battle tactics govern unit members' behavior during a command mission.
114.translation_description: Le tattiche di battaglia regolano il comportamento dei membri dell’unità durante una missione di comando.

115.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_361
115.description: Initially, only the tactic Independent is available, but more will be learned as you complete missions.
115.translation_description: All’inizio è disponibile solo la tattica «Indipendente», ma ne apprenderai altre completando missioni.

116.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_362
116.description: Other tactics include Offensive, Balanced, and Defensive. Each directs a unit member's behavior while offering unique enhancing effects.
116.translation_description: Le altre tattiche sono Offensiva, Equilibrata e Difensiva. Ognuna guida il comportamento di un membro dell’unità e offre effetti potenzianti unici.

117.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_363
117.description: These effects receive boosts as you complete missions and gain in tactics mastery.
117.translation_description: Questi effetti si potenziano man mano che completi missioni e acquisisci maggiore padronanza delle tattiche.

118.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_364
118.description: Battle tactics can be set ahead of a mission. To do so, speak with your soldiers in the barracks and select Display Orders.
118.translation_description: Puoi impostare le tattiche prima di una missione. Parla con i soldati in caserma e seleziona «Mostra Ordini».

119.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_370
119.description: You can cast glamours on the equipment of squadron members level 51 or above. To do so, speak with them and select Cast Glamour.
119.translation_description: Puoi applicare illusioni all’equipaggiamento dei membri della squadriglia dal livello 51 in su. Per farlo, parla con loro e seleziona «Applica Illusione».

120.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_371
120.description: You will be prompted to select an item in your inventory to lend its appearance. Though the process requires a catalyst, your gear will be retained.
120.translation_description: Ti verrà chiesto di scegliere un oggetto dell’inventario di cui applicare l’aspetto. Il procedimento richiede un catalizzatore, ma l’equipaggiamento originale verrà conservato.

121.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_100
121.description: Welcome to the squadron barracks, Commander! I've been fully debriefed on this new initiative, and stand ready to answer any questions you might have.
121.translation_description: Comandante, ti do il benvenuto nelle caserme della squadriglia! Ho ricevuto tutte le informazioni su questa nuova iniziativa e sono a disposizione per rispondere a ogni tua domanda.

122.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_136
122.description: First and foremost, however, we'll need to increase the number of squadron members. We have three recruits at present, but our squadron won't be ready to deploy until we have at least four.
122.translation_description: Per prima cosa, dovremo aumentare il numero dei membri della squadriglia. Al momento abbiamo tre reclute, ma non potremo partire per una missione finché non saremo almeno in quattro.

123.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_137
123.description: Your own deeds as an adventurer should serve to attract new recruits. All you need to do is choose from the hopefuls who submit their enlistment papers.
123.translation_description: Le tue imprese da avventuriero dovrebbero attirare nuove reclute. Dovrai solo scegliere tra chi presenta domanda di arruolamento.

124.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_138
124.description: By completing categories in your challenge log you will occasionally attract new recruits to your squadron.
124.translation_description: Completando le categorie del Registro Sfide, potresti attirare di tanto in tanto nuove reclute nella tua squadriglia.

125.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_139
125.description: You can decide which recruits you wish to add to your squadron after visiting the barracks and reading the enlistment papers.
125.translation_description: Dopo aver letto i moduli d’arruolamento in caserma, puoi decidere quali reclute accogliere nella tua squadriglia.

126.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_140
126.description: You can also check if recruits are available by opening the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> interface located under <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in the main menu.
126.translation_description: Puoi controllare se ci sono reclute disponibili anche nell’interfaccia <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, accessibile dal menu principale alla voce <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Incarichi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

127.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_141
127.description: Visit the barracks and read the enlistment papers to decide which recruits you wish to add to your squadron.
127.translation_description: Vai in caserma e leggi i moduli d’arruolamento per decidere quali reclute aggiungere alla tua squadriglia.

132.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_110
132.description: Ah, our fledgling squadron's first deployment!
132.translation_description: Ah, la prima missione della nostra squadriglia alle prime armi!

133.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_111
133.description: Now, ordinarily I would offer you a list of pre-approved duties to choose from, but I've taken the liberty of arranging a simple mission to ease the recruits into their roles.
133.translation_description: Di norma ti proporrei un elenco di incarichi già approvati tra cui scegliere, ma ho organizzato una missione semplice per aiutare le reclute a prendere confidenza con i loro ruoli.

134.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_112
134.description: All you need to do is confirm the squadron members and give the signal to deploy.
134.translation_description: Ti basterà confermare i membri della squadriglia e dare il segnale di partenza.

135.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_113
135.description: Squadron missions must be undertaken by a unit comprised of four members. Choose the recruits you deem suitable for the mission, and then select the “Deploy” button.
135.translation_description: Ogni missione della squadriglia richiede un’unità di quattro membri. Scegli le reclute più adatte all’incarico, poi seleziona il pulsante «Schiera».

136.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_120
136.description: The order has been given, Commander: the squadron is mission-bound.<hex:02100103>...Ah, I should also mention that each deployment is funded by company seals.
136.translation_description: L’ordine è stato impartito, Comandante: la squadriglia è in missione.<hex:02100103>Ah, devo anche aggiungere che ogni missione viene finanziata con i sigilli della Compagnia.

137.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_121
137.description: I've paid what's owed this time around, but the <hex:020812E1E93501FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF0103><hex:020820E1E93601FF184F72646572206F6620746865205477696E204164646572FF0103><hex:020818E1E93701FF10496D6D6F7274616C20466C616D6573FF0103> requires that their soldiers receive fair compensation. For future deployments, you'll need to pay the recruits yourself, Commander.
137.translation_description: Ho pagato io il dovuto questa volta, ma ai soldati <hex:020817E1E93501FF0F64656C6C612054656D7065737461FF0103><hex:02082BE1E93601FF2364656C6CE280994F7264696E652064656C6C61205669706572612047656D656C6C61FF0103><hex:02081FE1E93701FF1764656C6C65204669616D6D6520496D6D6F7274616C69FF0103> va garantito un compenso equo. Per le prossime missioni, Comandante, dovrai pagare personalmente le reclute.

138.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_122
138.description: And now we wait. Once the squadron has returned from their mission, speak to me and I'll provide you with a full report.
138.translation_description: Ora non resta che attendere. Quando la squadriglia sarà rientrata dalla missione, parlami e ti fornirò un rapporto completo.

141.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_126
141.description: Speak to the squadron sergeant to confirm the results of a mission.
141.translation_description: Parla con il sergente della squadriglia per confermare l’esito di una missione.

142.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_123
142.description: Squadron missions require 18 hours to complete (Earth time). The time remaining until a mission is completed can be viewed by opening the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> interface located under <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in the main menu.
142.translation_description: Le missioni della squadriglia richiedono 18 ore. Puoi controllare quanto manca al loro completamento aprendo l’interfaccia <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, accessibile dal menu principale alla voce <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Incarichi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

143.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_130
143.description: Let's see here...<hex:02100103>Aye, the recruits appear to have carried out their task in a sufficiently competent manner. You'd be surprised at how many privates manage to lose their way on a simple patrol route...
143.translation_description: Vediamo un po’...<hex:02100103>Sì, sembra che le reclute abbiano svolto il loro compito con sufficiente competenza. Ti stupirebbe sapere quanti soldati semplici riescono a perdersi durante una ronda così semplice...

144.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_131
144.description: In any case, a small success like this will improve the unit's cohesion and help sharpen their individual skills.
144.translation_description: In ogni caso, un piccolo successo come questo rafforzerà la coesione dell’unità e affinerà le capacità di ciascun membro.

147.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_134
147.description: Speak directly with the squadron sergeant to begin mission deployments or check mission reports.
147.translation_description: Parla direttamente con il sergente della squadriglia per avviare le missioni o consultarne i rapporti.

148.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_135
148.translation_description: Puoi completare ogni missione una volta a settimana. Lo stato delle missioni si azzera ogni <hex:020603120303><hex:020947DDFF09646F6D656E696361FF086C756E6564C3ACFF096D6172746564C3ACFF0B6D6572636F6C6564C3ACFF0967696F766564C3ACFF0976656E657264C3ACFF0773616261746F03> alle <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (ora terrestre).

149.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_010_136
149.description: Now let's talk training. Specialized instruction will improve the abilities of individual recruits, but its main purpose is to encourage the growth of the squadron as a whole.
149.translation_description: Ora parliamo di addestramento. L’istruzione specialistica migliora le capacità delle singole reclute, ma il suo scopo principale è far crescere l’intera squadriglia.

150.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_010_137
150.description: When you decide that the squadron's skills could use some sharpening, check the regimen board for a list of available training courses.
150.translation_description: Quando ritieni che la squadriglia debba affinare le proprie capacità, consulta il tabellone del programma di addestramento per vedere i corsi disponibili.

151.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_010_138
151.description: Aye, as much as I champion learning through doing, there are some things that need to be taught if the troops are to handle the tougher deployments.<hex:02100103>“The more ye bleed durin' trainin' the less ye'll bleed on the field!” as my old drill sergeant used to say...
151.translation_description: Sì, per quanto sostenga l’importanza di imparare facendo, alcune cose vanno insegnate se i soldati devono affrontare missioni più impegnative.<hex:02100103>«Più sangue versate durante l’addestramento, meno ne verserete sul campo!» diceva il mio vecchio sergente istruttore...

152.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_010_139
152.description: If we want this squadron to be the most elite unit in the <hex:020812E1E93501FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF0103><hex:020820E1E93601FF184F72646572206F6620746865205477696E204164646572FF0103><hex:020818E1E93701FF10496D6D6F7274616C20466C616D6573FF0103> then we'd best not neglect their military education!
152.translation_description: Se vogliamo che la nostra squadriglia diventi l’unità più d’élite <hex:020817E1E93501FF0F64656C6C612054656D7065737461FF0103><hex:02082BE1E93601FF2364656C6CE280994F7264696E652064656C6C61205669706572612047656D656C6C61FF0103><hex:02081FE1E93701FF1764656C6C65204669616D6D6520496D6D6F7274616C69FF0103>, non dobbiamo trascurare l’addestramento militare!

153.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_150
153.description: Our squadron has been improving by leaps and bounds, but I think it's time for the recruits to try their hands at a more challenging deployment. It's the only way they'll learn to push past their limits.
153.translation_description: La nostra squadriglia è cresciuta a passi da gigante, ma credo sia ora che le reclute si misurino con una missione più impegnativa. È l’unico modo per imparare a superare i propri limiti.

154.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_151
154.description: One or more squadron members have reached level 20, unlocking a special promotion mission. Successfully completing this mission will increase your squadron's rank.
154.translation_description: Uno o più membri della squadriglia hanno raggiunto il livello 20 e sbloccato una missione speciale di promozione. Completandola con successo, aumenterai il grado della squadriglia.

155.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_152
155.description: Due to the high difficulty level of the promotion mission, however, it is advised that you first improve your squadron members' individual attributes as much as possible before attempting a deployment.
155.translation_description: La missione di promozione è molto difficile: prima di affrontarla, ti consigliamo di migliorare quanto più possibile gli attributi individuali dei membri della squadriglia.

156.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_160
156.description: Congratulations, Commander! Thanks to your canny leadership, our squadron has proved itself yet again. The higher ups will be throwing some meatier assignments our way now, just you wait and see!
156.translation_description: Congratulazioni, Comandante! Grazie alla tua accorta guida, la squadriglia ha dimostrato ancora una volta il proprio valore. I superiori ci affideranno missioni più impegnative, vedrai!

157.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_161
157.description: Your squadron has attained Rank Two!<hex:02100103>As well as trainee missions, you will now have access to the higher difficulty “routine missions.”
157.translation_description: La tua squadriglia ha raggiunto il grado 2!<hex:02100103>Oltre alle missioni di addestramento, ora potrai affrontare le missioni ordinarie, più impegnative.

158.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_162
158.description: You have also received a copy of <hex:021A020203>Contemporary Warfare: Defense<hex:021A020103> as a reward for completing the promotion mission. This special item allows you to change a squadron member's class.
158.translation_description: Hai ricevuto una copia di <hex:021A020203>Contemporary Warfare: Defense<hex:021A020103> come ricompensa per aver completato la missione di promozione. Questo oggetto speciale permette di cambiare classe a un membro della squadriglia.

159.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_163
159.description: Check the regimen board and select the option to “View squadron roster.” Next, choose a squadron member, and use the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Change Class<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> subcommand to switch to the desired class.
159.translation_description: Consulta il tabellone del programma di addestramento e seleziona «Visualizza l’organico della squadriglia». Scegli un membro, poi usa il comando <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Change Class<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per assegnargli la classe desiderata.

160.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_170
160.description: Are you keeping an eye on squadron chemistry, Commander? It's surprising how much better the recruits perform when teamed with members that complement or challenge them.
160.translation_description: Tieni d’occhio l’alchimia della squadriglia, Comandante. È sorprendente quanto rendano meglio le reclute quando sono affiancate a membri che le completano o le mettono alla prova.

161.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_171
161.description: Relationships within a squadron can shift like the winds, though, so pray take that into consideration before ordering a deployment.
161.translation_description: I rapporti all’interno della squadriglia possono però cambiare come il vento, quindi ti prego di tenerne conto prima di ordinarne la partenza.

162.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_172
162.description: Upon returning from a mission, a squadron member will occasionally exhibit a preference for a certain squadron composition.
162.translation_description: Al rientro da una missione, un membro della squadriglia può manifestare una preferenza per una determinata composizione della squadra.

163.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_173
163.description: This “squadron chemistry” can affect the outcome of missions by improving attributes or increasing rewards, and its bonuses will come into play when meeting certain requirements. Requirements vary, but generally involve deploying a squadron composed of a certain combination of classes or races.
163.translation_description: Questa «alchimia della squadriglia» può influire sull’esito delle missioni migliorando gli attributi o aumentando le ricompense. I bonus si attivano soddisfacendo determinati requisiti, che in genere riguardano una specifica combinazione di classi o razze nella squadriglia.

164.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_174
164.description: Chemistry settings are accessed via the regimen board by selecting “View squadron roster,” then using the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Confirm Chemistry<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> subcommand after choosing a squadron member.
164.translation_description: Per configurare l’alchimia, apri il tabellone del programma di addestramento, seleziona «Visualizza l’organico della squadriglia», scegli un membro e usa il comando <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Confirm Chemistry<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

165.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_175
165.description: Simply exhibiting a chemistry preference provides no bonuses. Should you deploy a squadron on their next mission without first setting a chemistry effect, the bonus will disappear without effect.
165.translation_description: Avere una preferenza per l’alchimia non dà alcun bonus. Se schieri la squadriglia nella missione successiva senza prima attivare un effetto di alchimia disponibile, il bonus svanirà senza produrre effetti.

166.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_180
166.description: I can hardly recognize those green recruits we started with, Commander. In fact, I've heard rumors making the rounds in <hex:02081AE1E93501FF124D61656C7374726F6D20436F6D6D616E64FF0103><hex:020819E1E93601FF117468652041646465727327204E657374FF0103><hex:02081BE1E93701FF137468652048616C6C206F6620466C616D6573FF0103> that our squadron is on the short list for the next big assignment...
166.translation_description: Fatico a riconoscere quelle reclute inesperte di un tempo, Comandante. Anzi, ho sentito circolare voci <hex:020823E1E93501FF1B6E656C20436F6D616E646F2064656C6C612054656D7065737461FF0103><hex:02081EE1E93601FF166E656C204E69646F2064656C6C6520566970657265FF0103><hex:020820E1E93701FF186E656C6C612053616C612064656C6C65204669616D6D65FF0103> secondo cui la nostra squadriglia è tra le candidate per il prossimo grande incarico...

167.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_181
167.description: One or more squadron members have reached level 40, unlocking a special promotion mission. Successfully completing this mission will increase your squadron's rank.
167.translation_description: Uno o più membri della squadriglia hanno raggiunto il livello 40 e sbloccato una missione speciale di promozione. Completandola con successo, aumenterai il grado della squadriglia.

168.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_182
168.description: Due to the exceedingly high difficulty of the promotion mission, however, it is advised that you first improve your squadron members' individual attributes as much as possible before attempting a deployment.
168.translation_description: La missione di promozione è estremamente difficile: prima di affrontarla, ti consigliamo di migliorare quanto più possibile gli attributi individuali dei membri della squadriglia.

169.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_190
169.description: A close call by all accounts, but the squadron has returned safely from its deployment! Not everyone comes back from a mission like that, and the accolades have been flooding in from our sister companies. You should be proud, Commander!
169.translation_description: È stata una missione rischiosa, ma la squadriglia è rientrata sana e salva! Non tutti tornano da un incarico simile, e ci stanno arrivando un sacco di complimenti dalle altre Grandi Compagnie. Puoi esserne fiero, Comandante!

170.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_191
170.description: Your squadron has attained Rank Three!<hex:02100103>You now have access to the higher difficulty “priority missions.”
170.translation_description: La tua squadriglia ha raggiunto il grado 3!<hex:02100103>Ora puoi affrontare le missioni prioritarie, di difficoltà maggiore.

171.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_192
171.description: Completing priority missions earns you special rewards, so be sure to deploy your squadron on these challenging duties.
171.translation_description: Le missioni prioritarie offrono ricompense speciali: schiera la tua squadriglia per affrontare questi incarichi impegnativi.

172.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_193
172.description: Be aware, however, that a successful completion will lock access to other priority missions until the timer resets.
172.translation_description: Attenzione: dopo aver completato una missione prioritaria, non potrai accedere alle altre finché il timer non si sarà azzerato.

173.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_194
173.translation_description: Lo stato delle missioni prioritarie si azzera ogni <hex:020603120303><hex:020947DDFF09646F6D656E696361FF086C756E6564C3ACFF096D6172746564C3ACFF0B6D6572636F6C6564C3ACFF0967696F766564C3ACFF0976656E657264C3ACFF0773616261746F03> alle <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (ora terrestre).

174.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_195
174.description: ...Ah, and before I forget: there was one other matter to which we must attend.
174.translation_description: ...Ah, prima che mi dimentichi: c’è un’altra questione di cui dobbiamo occuparci.

175.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_196
175.description: We've received a missive from <hex:02081AE1E93501FF124D61656C7374726F6D20436F6D6D616E64FF0103><hex:020819E1E93601FF117468652041646465727327204E657374FF0103><hex:02081BE1E93701FF137468652048616C6C206F6620466C616D6573FF0103> regarding your performance. If you'll permit me...

177.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_198
177.description: A letter of promotion! Congratulations, Commander! And very well deserved, I must say!
177.translation_description: Una lettera di promozione! Congratulazioni, Comandante! E permettimi di dire che te la sei meritata in pieno!

179.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_331
179.description: <hex:021A020203>For ongoing excellence in the Adventurer Squadron initiative, <hex:022B7EFF7C020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350903FF0103020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360903FF0103020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370903FF010303> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>'s squadron is hereby granted authorization to undertake command missions. Effective immediately.<hex:021A020103>
179.translation_description: <hex:021A020203>Per l’impegno costante nell’iniziativa della squadriglia di avventurieri, <hex:022B7EFF7C020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350903FF0103020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360903FF0103020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370903FF010303> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303> ha ora l’autorizzazione a svolgere missioni di comando con la propria squadriglia. L’autorizzazione ha effetto immediato.<hex:021A020103>

180.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_332
180.description: Well, an expansion of our sphere of activity! This is proof positive of the company's faith in us, Commander.
180.translation_description: Un ampliamento del nostro raggio d’azione! Comandante, questa è la prova lampante della fiducia che la Compagnia ripone in noi.

181.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_333
181.description: Conversely, it also means that expectations run higher. Let us set about our task with renewed vigor and continue on our exemplary course!
181.translation_description: Le aspettative, però, saranno più alte. Impegniamoci con rinnovato slancio e proseguiamo sulla strada esemplare che abbiamo intrapreso!

182.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_334
182.description: You now have access to command missions. These duties put you at the head of a four-man unit─yourself and three soldiers─for a foray into an instanced dungeon.
182.translation_description: Ora puoi intraprendere missioni di comando. Questi incarichi ti mettono a capo di un’unità di quattro persone—tu e tre soldati—per affrontare un spedizione in un’istanza dedicata.

183.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_335
183.description: Command missions may be undertaken by speaking with the squadron sergeant. Successful completion may yield unique rewards.
183.translation_description: Puoi intraprendere missioni di comando parlando con il sergente della squadriglia. Completandole con successo, potresti ottenere ricompense uniche.

184.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_336
184.description: If you wish to know more, please refer to the squadron guide.
184.translation_description: Per saperne di più, consulta la guida della squadriglia.

186.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_210
186.description: The squadron has returned from their deployment. Pray look over the report, Commander.
186.translation_description: La squadriglia è rientrata dalla missione. Esamina il rapporto, Comandante.

187.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_220
187.description: ...Ah, and before I forget: there was one other matter to which we must attend.
187.translation_description: ...Ah, prima che mi dimentichi: c’è un’altra questione di cui dobbiamo occuparci.

188.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_221
188.description: We've received a missive from <hex:02081AE1E93501FF124D61656C7374726F6D20436F6D6D616E64FF0103><hex:020819E1E93601FF117468652041646465727327204E657374FF0103><hex:02081BE1E93701FF137468652048616C6C206F6620466C616D6573FF0103> regarding your performance. If you'll permit me...

190.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_223
190.description: A letter of promotion! Congratulations, Commander! And very well deserved, I must say!
190.translation_description: Una lettera di promozione! Congratulazioni, Comandante! E permettimi di dire che te la sei meritata in pieno!

191.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_230
191.description: Greetings, Commander. The squadron is eager to receive your next orders!
191.translation_description: Salve, Comandante. La squadriglia non vede l’ora di ricevere i tuoi prossimi ordini!

192.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_240
192.description: Greetings, Commander. The squadron is performing well, but let's keep up the pace! How shall we proceed? Mission deployment or training?
192.translation_description: Salve, Comandante. La squadriglia sta procedendo bene, ma manteniamo il ritmo! Come vuoi proseguire: con una missione o con l’addestramento?

193.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_250
193.description: We have three eager recruits, but we need to enlist at least one more member before we can call ourselves a squadron. Let's get this barracks filled, Commander!
193.translation_description: Abbiamo tre reclute impazienti di partire, ma ne dobbiamo arruolare almeno un’altra prima di poterci definire una squadriglia. Riempiamo queste caserme, Comandante!

194.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_251
194.description: Your own deeds as an adventurer should serve to attract new recruits─all you need to do is choose from the hopefuls who submit their enlistment papers.
194.translation_description: Le tue imprese da avventuriero dovrebbero attirare nuove reclute: dovrai solo scegliere tra chi presenta domanda di arruolamento.

195.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_252
195.description: By completing categories in your challenge log you will occasionally attract new recruits to your squadron.
195.translation_description: Completando le categorie del Registro Sfide, potresti attirare di tanto in tanto nuove reclute nella tua squadriglia.

196.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_260
196.description: Have you given any thought to training? Specialized instruction will improve the abilities of individual recruits, but its main purpose is to encourage the growth of the squadron as a whole.
196.translation_description: Hai pensato all’addestramento? L’istruzione specialistica migliora le capacità delle singole reclute, ma il suo scopo principale è far crescere l’intera squadriglia.

197.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_261
197.description: When you decide that the squadron's skills could use some sharpening, check the regimen board for a list of available training courses.
197.translation_description: Quando ritieni che la squadriglia debba affinare le proprie capacità, consulta il tabellone del programma di addestramento per vedere i corsi disponibili.

198.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_262
198.description: Aye, as much as I champion learning through doing, there are some things that need to be taught if the troops are to handle the tougher deployments.<hex:02100103>“The more ye bleed durin' trainin' the less ye'll bleed on the field!” as my old drill sergeant used to say...
198.translation_description: Sì, per quanto sostenga l’importanza di imparare facendo, alcune cose vanno insegnate se i soldati devono affrontare missioni più impegnative.<hex:02100103>«Più sangue versate durante l’addestramento, meno ne verserete sul campo!» diceva il mio vecchio sergente istruttore...

199.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_263
199.description: If we want this squadron to be the most elite unit in the <hex:020812E1E93501FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF0103><hex:020820E1E93601FF184F72646572206F6620746865205477696E204164646572FF0103><hex:020818E1E93701FF10496D6D6F7274616C20466C616D6573FF0103> then we'd best not neglect their military education!
199.translation_description: Se vogliamo che la nostra squadriglia diventi l’unità più d’élite <hex:020817E1E93501FF0F64656C6C612054656D7065737461FF0103><hex:02082BE1E93601FF2364656C6CE280994F7264696E652064656C6C61205669706572612047656D656C6C61FF0103><hex:02081FE1E93701FF1764656C6C65204669616D6D6520496D6D6F7274616C69FF0103>, non dobbiamo trascurare l’addestramento militare!

200.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_320
200.description: Commander. Our squadron appears to be gaining a solid reputation within the <hex:020812E1E93501FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF0103><hex:02080EE1E93601FF064F72646572FF0103><hex:02080FE1E93701FF07466C616D6573FF0103>.
200.translation_description: Comandante, la nostra squadriglia sta guadagnando un’ottima reputazione <hex:020817E1E93501FF0F6E656C6C612054656D7065737461FF0103><hex:020816E1E93601FF0E6E656C6CE280994F7264696E65FF0103><hex:02081FE1E93701FF176E656C6C65204669616D6D6520496D6D6F7274616C69FF0103>.

201.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_321
201.description: Expectations are high, and I think it's time we deployed the troops on a mission that truly tests the limits of their capabilities.
201.translation_description: Le aspettative sono alte e credo sia arrivato il momento di mandare i soldati in una missione che metta davvero alla prova le loro capacità.

202.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_322
202.description: A special promotion mission is currently available in the list of routine missions. Successfully completing this mission will increase your squadron's rank.
202.translation_description: Una missione speciale di promozione è ora disponibile tra le missioni ordinarie. Completandola con successo, aumenterai il grado della tua squadriglia.

203.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_100
203.description: Welcome to the squadron barracks, Commander! I've been fully debriefed on this new initiative, and stand ready to answer any questions you might have.
203.translation_description: Comandante, ti do il benvenuto nelle caserme della squadriglia! Ho ricevuto tutte le informazioni su questa nuova iniziativa e sono a disposizione per rispondere a ogni tua domanda.

204.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_136
204.description: First and foremost, however, we'll need to increase the number of squadron members. We have three recruits at present, but our squadron won't be ready to deploy until we have at least four.
204.translation_description: Per prima cosa, dovremo aumentare il numero dei membri della squadriglia. Al momento abbiamo tre reclute, ma non potremo partire per una missione finché non saremo almeno in quattro.

205.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_137
205.description: Your own deeds as an adventurer should serve to attract new recruits. All you need to do is choose from the hopefuls who submit their enlistment papers.
205.translation_description: Le tue imprese da avventuriero dovrebbero attirare nuove reclute. Dovrai solo scegliere tra chi presenta domanda di arruolamento.

209.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_110
209.description: Ah, our fledgling squadron's first deployment!
209.translation_description: Ah, la prima missione della nostra squadriglia alle prime armi!

210.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_111
210.description: Now, ordinarily I would offer you a list of pre-approved duties to choose from, but I've taken the liberty of arranging a simple mission to ease the recruits into their roles.
210.translation_description: Di norma ti proporrei un elenco di incarichi già approvati tra cui scegliere, ma ho organizzato una missione semplice per aiutare le reclute a prendere confidenza con i loro ruoli.

211.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_112
211.description: All you need to do is confirm the squadron members and give the signal to deploy.
211.translation_description: Ti basterà confermare i membri della squadriglia e dare il segnale di partenza.

212.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_120
212.description: The order has been given, Commander: the squadron is mission-bound.<hex:02100103>...Ah, I should also mention that each deployment is funded by company seals.
212.translation_description: L’ordine è stato impartito, Comandante: la squadriglia è in missione.<hex:02100103>Ah, devo anche aggiungere che ogni missione viene finanziata con i sigilli della Compagnia.

213.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_121
213.description: I've paid what's owed this time around, but the <hex:020812E1E93501FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF0103><hex:020820E1E93601FF184F72646572206F6620746865205477696E204164646572FF0103><hex:020818E1E93701FF10496D6D6F7274616C20466C616D6573FF0103> requires that their soldiers receive fair compensation. For future deployments, you'll need to pay the recruits yourself, Commander.
213.translation_description: Ho pagato io il dovuto questa volta, ma ai soldati <hex:020817E1E93501FF0F64656C6C612054656D7065737461FF0103><hex:02082BE1E93601FF2364656C6CE280994F7264696E652064656C6C61205669706572612047656D656C6C61FF0103><hex:02081FE1E93701FF1764656C6C65204669616D6D6520496D6D6F7274616C69FF0103> va garantito un compenso equo. Per le prossime missioni, Comandante, dovrai pagare personalmente le reclute.

214.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_122
214.description: And now we wait. Once the squadron has returned from their mission, speak to me and I'll provide you with a full report.
214.translation_description: Ora non resta che attendere. Quando la squadriglia sarà rientrata dalla missione, parlami e ti fornirò un rapporto completo.

217.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_130
217.description: Let's see here...<hex:02100103>Aye, the recruits appear to have carried out their task in a sufficiently competent manner. You'd be surprised at how many privates manage to lose their way on a simple patrol route...
217.translation_description: Vediamo un po’...<hex:02100103>Sì, sembra che le reclute abbiano svolto il loro compito con sufficiente competenza. Ti stupirebbe sapere quanti soldati semplici riescono a perdersi durante una ronda così semplice...

218.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_131
218.description: In any case, a small success like this will improve the unit's cohesion and help sharpen their individual skills.
218.translation_description: In ogni caso, un piccolo successo come questo rafforzerà la coesione dell’unità e affinerà le capacità di ciascun membro.

221.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_110_136
221.description: Now let's talk training. Specialized instruction will improve the abilities of individual recruits, but its main purpose is to encourage the growth of the squadron as a whole.
221.translation_description: Ora parliamo di addestramento. L’istruzione specialistica migliora le capacità delle singole reclute, ma il suo scopo principale è far crescere l’intera squadriglia.

222.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_110_137
222.description: When you decide that the squadron's skills could use some sharpening, check the regimen board for a list of available training courses.
222.translation_description: Quando ritieni che la squadriglia debba affinare le proprie capacità, consulta il tabellone del programma di addestramento per vedere i corsi disponibili.

223.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_110_138
223.description: Aye, as much as I champion learning through doing, there are some things that need to be taught if the troops are to handle the tougher deployments.<hex:02100103>“The more ye bleed durin' trainin' the less ye'll bleed on the field!” as my old drill sergeant used to say...

224.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_110_139
224.description: If we want this squadron to be the most elite unit in the <hex:020812E1E93501FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF0103><hex:020820E1E93601FF184F72646572206F6620746865205477696E204164646572FF0103><hex:020818E1E93701FF10496D6D6F7274616C20466C616D6573FF0103> then we'd best not neglect their military education!
224.translation_description: Se vogliamo che la nostra squadriglia diventi l’unità più d’élite <hex:020817E1E93501FF0F64656C6C612054656D7065737461FF0103><hex:02082BE1E93601FF2364656C6CE280994F7264696E652064656C6C61205669706572612047656D656C6C61FF0103><hex:02081FE1E93701FF1764656C6C65204669616D6D6520496D6D6F7274616C69FF0103>, non dobbiamo trascurare l’addestramento militare!

225.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_150
225.description: Our squadron has been improving by leaps and bounds, but I think it's time for the recruits to try their hands at a more challenging deployment. It's the only way they'll learn to push past their limits.
225.translation_description: La nostra squadriglia è cresciuta a passi da gigante, ma credo sia ora che le reclute si misurino con una missione più impegnativa. È l’unico modo per imparare a superare i propri limiti.

226.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_160
226.description: Congratulations, Commander! Thanks to your canny leadership, our squadron has proved itself yet again. The higher ups will be throwing some meatier assignments our way now, just you wait and see!
226.translation_description: Congratulazioni, Comandante! Grazie alla tua accorta guida, la squadriglia ha dimostrato ancora una volta il proprio valore. I superiori ci affideranno missioni più impegnative, vedrai!

227.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_170
227.description: Are you keeping an eye on squadron chemistry, Commander? It's surprising how much better the recruits perform when teamed with members that complement or challenge them.
227.translation_description: Tieni d’occhio l’alchimia della squadriglia, Comandante. È sorprendente quanto rendano meglio le reclute quando sono affiancate a membri che le completano o le mettono alla prova.

228.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_171
228.description: Relationships within a squadron can shift like the winds, though, so pray take that into consideration before ordering a deployment.
228.translation_description: I rapporti all’interno della squadriglia possono però cambiare come il vento, quindi ti prego di tenerne conto prima di ordinarne la partenza.

229.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_180
229.description: I can hardly recognize those green recruits we started with, Commander. In fact, I've heard rumors making the rounds in <hex:02081AE1E93501FF124D61656C7374726F6D20436F6D6D616E64FF0103><hex:020819E1E93601FF117468652041646465727327204E657374FF0103><hex:02081BE1E93701FF137468652048616C6C206F6620466C616D6573FF0103> that our squadron is on the short list for the next big assignment...
229.translation_description: Fatico a riconoscere quelle reclute inesperte di un tempo, Comandante. Anzi, ho sentito circolare voci <hex:020823E1E93501FF1B6E656C20436F6D616E646F2064656C6C612054656D7065737461FF0103><hex:02081EE1E93601FF166E656C204E69646F2064656C6C6520566970657265FF0103><hex:020820E1E93701FF186E656C6C612053616C612064656C6C65204669616D6D65FF0103> secondo cui la nostra squadriglia è tra le candidate per il prossimo grande incarico...

230.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_190
230.description: A close call by all accounts, but the squadron has returned safely from its deployment! Not everyone comes back from a mission like that, and the accolades have been flooding in from our sister companies. You should be proud, Commander!
230.translation_description: È stata una missione rischiosa, ma la squadriglia è rientrata sana e salva! Non tutti tornano da un incarico simile, e ci stanno arrivando un sacco di complimenti dalle altre Grandi Compagnie. Puoi esserne fiero, Comandante!

231.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_195
231.description: ...Ah, and before I forget: there was one other matter to which we must attend.
231.translation_description: ...Ah, prima che mi dimentichi: c’è un’altra questione di cui dobbiamo occuparci.

232.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_196
232.description: We've received a missive from <hex:02081AE1E93501FF124D61656C7374726F6D20436F6D6D616E64FF0103><hex:020819E1E93601FF117468652041646465727327204E657374FF0103><hex:02081BE1E93701FF137468652048616C6C206F6620466C616D6573FF0103> regarding your performance. If you'll permit me...

234.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_198
234.description: A letter of promotion! Congratulations, Commander! And very well deserved, I must say!
234.translation_description: Una lettera di promozione! Congratulazioni, Comandante! E permettimi di dire che te la sei meritata in pieno!

236.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_331
236.description: <hex:021A020203>For ongoing excellence in the Adventurer Squadron initiative, <hex:022B7EFF7C020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350903FF0103020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360903FF0103020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370903FF010303> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>'s squadron is hereby granted authorization to undertake command missions. Effective immediately.<hex:021A020103>
236.translation_description: <hex:021A020203>Per l’impegno costante nell’iniziativa della squadriglia di avventurieri, <hex:022B7EFF7C020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350903FF0103020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360903FF0103020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370903FF010303> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303> ha ora l’autorizzazione a svolgere missioni di comando con la propria squadriglia. L’autorizzazione ha effetto immediato.<hex:021A020103>

237.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_332
237.description: Well, an expansion of our sphere of activity! This is proof positive of the company's faith in us, Commander.
237.translation_description: Un ampliamento del nostro raggio d’azione! Comandante, questa è la prova lampante della fiducia che la Compagnia ripone in noi.

238.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_333
238.description: Conversely, it also means that expectations run higher. Let us set about our task with renewed vigor and continue on our exemplary course!
238.translation_description: Le aspettative, però, saranno più alte. Impegniamoci con rinnovato slancio e proseguiamo sulla strada esemplare che abbiamo intrapreso!

239.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_210
239.description: The squadron has returned from their deployment. Pray look over the report, Commander.
239.translation_description: La squadriglia è rientrata dalla missione. Esamina il rapporto, Comandante.

240.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_220
240.description: ...Ah, and before I forget: there was one other matter to which we must attend.
240.translation_description: ...Ah, prima che mi dimentichi: c’è un’altra questione di cui dobbiamo occuparci.

243.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_223
243.description: A letter of promotion! Congratulations, Commander! And very well deserved, I must say!
243.translation_description: Una lettera di promozione! Congratulazioni, Comandante! E permettimi di dire che te la sei meritata in pieno!

244.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_230
244.description: Greetings, Commander. The squadron is eager to receive your next orders!
244.translation_description: Salve, Comandante. La squadriglia non vede l’ora di ricevere i tuoi prossimi ordini!

245.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_240
245.description: Greetings, Commander. The squadron is performing well, but let's keep up the pace! How shall we proceed? Mission deployment or training?
245.translation_description: Salve, Comandante. La squadriglia sta procedendo bene, ma manteniamo il ritmo! Come vuoi proseguire: con una missione o con l’addestramento?

246.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_250
246.description: We have three eager recruits, but we need to enlist at least one more member before we can call ourselves a squadron. Let's get this barracks filled, Commander!
246.translation_description: Abbiamo tre reclute impazienti di partire, ma ne dobbiamo arruolare almeno un’altra prima di poterci definire una squadriglia. Riempiamo queste caserme, Comandante!

247.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_251
247.description: Your own deeds as an adventurer should serve to attract new recruits─all you need to do is choose from the hopefuls who submit their enlistment papers.
247.translation_description: Le tue imprese da avventuriero dovrebbero attirare nuove reclute: dovrai solo scegliere tra chi presenta domanda di arruolamento.

248.description: Have you given any thought to training? Specialized instruction will improve the abilities of individual recruits, but its main purpose is to encourage the growth of the squadron as a whole.
248.translation_description: Hai pensato all’addestramento? L’istruzione specialistica migliora le capacità delle singole reclute, ma il suo scopo principale è far crescere l’intera squadriglia.
