261.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_111
261.description: Now, ordinarily I would offer you a list of pre-approved duties to choose from, but I've taken the liberty of arranging a simple mission to ease the recruits into their roles.
261.translation_description: Di norma ti proporrei un elenco di incarichi già approvati tra cui scegliere, ma ho organizzato una missione semplice per aiutare le reclute a prendere confidenza con i loro ruoli.

262.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_112
262.description: All you need to do is confirm the squadron members and give the signal to deploy.
262.translation_description: Ti basterà confermare i membri della squadriglia e dare il segnale di partenza.

263.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_120
263.description: The order has been given, Commander: the squadron is mission-bound.<hex:02100103>...Ah, I should also mention that each deployment is funded by company seals.
263.translation_description: L’ordine è stato impartito, Comandante: la squadriglia è in missione.<hex:02100103>Ah, devo anche aggiungere che ogni missione viene finanziata con i sigilli della Compagnia.

264.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_121
264.description: I've paid what's owed this time around, but the <hex:020812E1E93501FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF0103><hex:020820E1E93601FF184F72646572206F6620746865205477696E204164646572FF0103><hex:020818E1E93701FF10496D6D6F7274616C20466C616D6573FF0103> requires that their soldiers receive fair compensation. For future deployments, you'll need to pay the recruits yourself, Commander.
264.translation_description: Ho pagato io il dovuto questa volta, ma ai soldati <hex:020817E1E93501FF0F64656C6C612054656D7065737461FF0103><hex:02082BE1E93601FF2364656C6CE280994F7264696E652064656C6C61205669706572612047656D656C6C61FF0103><hex:02081FE1E93701FF1764656C6C65204669616D6D6520496D6D6F7274616C69FF0103> va garantito un compenso equo. Per le prossime missioni, Comandante, dovrai pagare personalmente le reclute.

265.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_122
265.description: And now we wait. Once the squadron has returned from their mission, speak to me and I'll provide you with a full report.
265.translation_description: Ora non resta che attendere. Quando la squadriglia sarà rientrata dalla missione, parlami e ti fornirò un rapporto completo.

268.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_130
268.description: Let's see here...<hex:02100103>Aye, the recruits appear to have carried out their task in a sufficiently competent manner. You'd be surprised at how many privates manage to lose their way on a simple patrol route...
268.translation_description: Vediamo un po’...<hex:02100103>Sì, sembra che le reclute abbiano svolto il loro compito con sufficiente competenza. Ti stupirebbe sapere quanti soldati semplici riescono a perdersi durante una ronda così semplice...

269.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_131
269.description: In any case, a small success like this will improve the unit's cohesion and help sharpen their individual skills.
269.translation_description: In ogni caso, un piccolo successo come questo rafforzerà la coesione dell’unità e affinerà le capacità di ciascun membro.

272.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_210_136
272.description: Now let's talk training. Specialized instruction will improve the abilities of individual recruits, but its main purpose is to encourage the growth of the squadron as a whole.
272.translation_description: Ora parliamo di addestramento. L’istruzione specialistica migliora le capacità delle singole reclute, ma il suo scopo principale è far crescere l’intera squadriglia.

273.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_210_137
273.description: When you decide that the squadron's skills could use some sharpening, check the regimen board for a list of available training courses.
273.translation_description: Quando ritieni che la squadriglia debba affinare le proprie capacità, consulta il tabellone del programma di addestramento per vedere i corsi disponibili.

274.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_210_138
274.description: Aye, as much as I champion learning through doing, there are some things that need to be taught if the troops are to handle the tougher deployments.<hex:02100103>“The more ye bleed durin' trainin' the less ye'll bleed on the field!” as my old drill sergeant used to say...
274.translation_description: Sì, per quanto sostenga l’importanza di imparare facendo, alcune cose vanno insegnate se i soldati devono affrontare missioni più impegnative.<hex:02100103>«Più sangue versate durante l’addestramento, meno ne verserete sul campo!» diceva il mio vecchio sergente istruttore...

275.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_210_139
275.description: If we want this squadron to be the most elite unit in the <hex:020812E1E93501FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF0103><hex:020820E1E93601FF184F72646572206F6620746865205477696E204164646572FF0103><hex:020818E1E93701FF10496D6D6F7274616C20466C616D6573FF0103> then we'd best not neglect their military education!
275.translation_description: Se vogliamo che la nostra squadriglia diventi l’unità più d’élite <hex:020817E1E93501FF0F64656C6C612054656D7065737461FF0103><hex:02082BE1E93601FF2364656C6CE280994F7264696E652064656C6C61205669706572612047656D656C6C61FF0103><hex:02081FE1E93701FF1764656C6C65204669616D6D6520496D6D6F7274616C69FF0103>, non dobbiamo trascurare l’addestramento militare!

276.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_150
276.description: Our squadron has been improving by leaps and bounds, but I think it's time for the recruits to try their hands at a more challenging deployment. It's the only way they'll learn to push past their limits.
276.translation_description: La nostra squadriglia è cresciuta a passi da gigante, ma credo sia ora che le reclute si misurino con una missione più impegnativa. È l’unico modo per imparare a superare i propri limiti.

277.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_160
277.description: Congratulations, Commander! Thanks to your canny leadership, our squadron has proved itself yet again. The higher ups will be throwing some meatier assignments our way now, just you wait and see!
277.translation_description: Congratulazioni, Comandante! Grazie alla tua accorta guida, la squadriglia ha dimostrato ancora una volta il proprio valore. I superiori ci affideranno missioni più impegnative, vedrai!

278.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_170
278.description: Are you keeping an eye on squadron chemistry, Commander? It's surprising how much better the recruits perform when teamed with members that complement or challenge them.
278.translation_description: Tieni d’occhio l’alchimia della squadriglia, Comandante. È sorprendente quanto rendano meglio le reclute quando sono affiancate a membri che le completano o le mettono alla prova.

279.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_171
279.description: Relationships within a squadron can shift like the winds, though, so pray take that into consideration before ordering a deployment.
279.translation_description: I rapporti all’interno della squadriglia possono però cambiare come il vento, quindi ti prego di tenerne conto prima di ordinarne la partenza.

280.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_180
280.description: I can hardly recognize those green recruits we started with, Commander. In fact, I've heard rumors making the rounds in <hex:02081AE1E93501FF124D61656C7374726F6D20436F6D6D616E64FF0103><hex:020819E1E93601FF117468652041646465727327204E657374FF0103><hex:02081BE1E93701FF137468652048616C6C206F6620466C616D6573FF0103> that our squadron is on the short list for the next big assignment...
280.translation_description: Fatico a riconoscere quelle reclute inesperte di un tempo, Comandante. Anzi, ho sentito circolare voci <hex:020823E1E93501FF1B6E656C20436F6D616E646F2064656C6C612054656D7065737461FF0103><hex:02081EE1E93601FF166E656C204E69646F2064656C6C6520566970657265FF0103><hex:020820E1E93701FF186E656C6C612053616C612064656C6C65204669616D6D65FF0103> secondo cui la nostra squadriglia è tra le candidate per il prossimo grande incarico...

281.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_190
281.description: A close call by all accounts, but the squadron has returned safely from its deployment! Not everyone comes back from a mission like that, and the accolades have been flooding in from our sister companies. You should be proud, Commander!
281.translation_description: È stata una missione rischiosa, ma la squadriglia è rientrata sana e salva! Non tutti tornano da un incarico simile, e ci stanno arrivando un sacco di complimenti dalle altre Grandi Compagnie. Puoi esserne fiero, Comandante!

282.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_195
282.description: ...Ah, and before I forget: there was one other matter to which we must attend.
282.translation_description: ...Ah, prima che mi dimentichi: c’è un’altra questione di cui dobbiamo occuparci.

283.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_196
283.description: We've received a missive from <hex:02081AE1E93501FF124D61656C7374726F6D20436F6D6D616E64FF0103><hex:020819E1E93601FF117468652041646465727327204E657374FF0103><hex:02081BE1E93701FF137468652048616C6C206F6620466C616D6573FF0103> regarding your performance. If you'll permit me...

285.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_198
285.description: A letter of promotion! Congratulations, Commander! And very well deserved, I must say!
285.translation_description: Una lettera di promozione! Congratulazioni, Comandante! E permettimi di dire che te la sei meritata in pieno!

286.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_330
286.description: We've received a missive from <hex:02081AE1E93501FF124D61656C7374726F6D20436F6D6D616E64FF0103><hex:020819E1E93601FF117468652041646465727327204E657374FF0103><hex:02081BE1E93701FF137468652048616C6C206F6620466C616D6573FF0103> regarding your performance. If you'll permit me...

287.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_331
287.description: <hex:021A020203>For ongoing excellence in the Adventurer Squadron initiative, <hex:022B7EFF7C020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350903FF0103020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360903FF0103020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370903FF010303> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>'s squadron is hereby granted authorization to undertake command missions. Effective immediately.<hex:021A020103>
287.translation_description: <hex:021A020203>Per l’impegno costante nell’iniziativa della squadriglia di avventurieri, <hex:022B7EFF7C020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350903FF0103020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360903FF0103020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370903FF010303> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303> ha ora l’autorizzazione a svolgere missioni di comando con la propria squadriglia. L’autorizzazione ha effetto immediato.<hex:021A020103>

288.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_332
288.description: Well, an expansion of our sphere of activity! This is proof positive of the company's faith in us, Commander.
288.translation_description: Un ampliamento del nostro raggio d’azione! Comandante, questa è la prova lampante della fiducia che la Compagnia ripone in noi.

289.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_333
289.description: Conversely, it also means that expectations run higher. Let us set about our task with renewed vigor and continue on our exemplary course!
289.translation_description: Le aspettative, però, saranno più alte. Impegniamoci con rinnovato slancio e proseguiamo sulla strada esemplare che abbiamo intrapreso!

290.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_210
290.description: The squadron has returned from their deployment. Pray look over the report, Commander.
290.translation_description: La squadriglia è rientrata dalla missione. Esamina il rapporto, Comandante.

291.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_220
291.description: ...Ah, and before I forget: there was one other matter to which we must attend.
291.translation_description: ...Ah, prima che mi dimentichi: c’è un’altra questione di cui dobbiamo occuparci.

292.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_221
292.description: We've received a missive from <hex:02081AE1E93501FF124D61656C7374726F6D20436F6D6D616E64FF0103><hex:020819E1E93601FF117468652041646465727327204E657374FF0103><hex:02081BE1E93701FF137468652048616C6C206F6620466C616D6573FF0103> regarding your performance. If you'll permit me...

294.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_223
294.description: A letter of promotion! Congratulations, Commander! And very well deserved, I must say!
294.translation_description: Una lettera di promozione! Congratulazioni, Comandante! E permettimi di dire che te la sei meritata in pieno!

295.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_230
295.description: Greetings, Commander. The squadron is eager to receive your next orders!
295.translation_description: Salve, Comandante. La squadriglia non vede l’ora di ricevere i tuoi prossimi ordini!

296.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_240
296.description: Greetings, Commander. The squadron is performing well, but let's keep up the pace! How shall we proceed? Mission deployment or training?
296.translation_description: Salve, Comandante. La squadriglia sta procedendo bene, ma manteniamo il ritmo! Come vuoi proseguire: con una missione o con l’addestramento?

297.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_250
297.description: We have three eager recruits, but we need to enlist at least one more member before we can call ourselves a squadron. Let's get this barracks filled, Commander!
297.translation_description: Abbiamo tre reclute impazienti di partire, ma ne dobbiamo arruolare almeno un’altra prima di poterci definire una squadriglia. Riempiamo queste caserme, Comandante!

298.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_251
298.description: Your own deeds as an adventurer should serve to attract new recruits─all you need to do is choose from the hopefuls who submit their enlistment papers.
298.translation_description: Le tue imprese da avventuriero dovrebbero attirare nuove reclute: dovrai solo scegliere tra chi presenta domanda di arruolamento.

299.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_260
299.description: Have you given any thought to training? Specialized instruction will improve the abilities of individual recruits, but its main purpose is to encourage the growth of the squadron as a whole.
299.translation_description: Hai pensato all’addestramento? L’istruzione specialistica migliora le capacità delle singole reclute, ma il suo scopo principale è far crescere l’intera squadriglia.

300.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_261
300.description: When you decide that the squadron's skills could use some sharpening, check the regimen board for a list of available training courses.
300.translation_description: Quando ritieni che la squadriglia debba affinare le proprie capacità, consulta il tabellone del programma di addestramento per vedere i corsi disponibili.

301.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_262
301.description: Aye, as much as I champion learning through doing, there are some things that need to be taught if the troops are to handle the tougher deployments.<hex:02100103>“The more ye bleed durin' trainin' the less ye'll bleed on the field!” as my old drill sergeant used to say...
301.translation_description: Sì, per quanto sostenga l’importanza di imparare facendo, alcune cose vanno insegnate se i soldati devono affrontare missioni più impegnative.<hex:02100103>«Più sangue versate durante l’addestramento, meno ne verserete sul campo!» diceva il mio vecchio sergente istruttore...

302.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_263
302.description: If we want this squadron to be the most elite unit in the <hex:020812E1E93501FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF0103><hex:020820E1E93601FF184F72646572206F6620746865205477696E204164646572FF0103><hex:020818E1E93701FF10496D6D6F7274616C20466C616D6573FF0103> then we'd best not neglect their military education!
302.translation_description: Se vogliamo che la nostra squadriglia diventi l’unità più d’élite <hex:020817E1E93501FF0F64656C6C612054656D7065737461FF0103><hex:02082BE1E93601FF2364656C6CE280994F7264696E652064656C6C61205669706572612047656D656C6C61FF0103><hex:02081FE1E93701FF1764656C6C65204669616D6D6520496D6D6F7274616C69FF0103>, non dobbiamo trascurare l’addestramento militare!

303.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_320
303.description: Commander. Our squadron appears to be gaining a solid reputation within the <hex:020812E1E93501FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF0103><hex:02080EE1E93601FF064F72646572FF0103><hex:02080FE1E93701FF07466C616D6573FF0103>.
303.translation_description: Comandante, la nostra squadriglia sta guadagnando un’ottima reputazione <hex:020817E1E93501FF0F6E656C6C612054656D7065737461FF0103><hex:020816E1E93601FF0E6E656C6CE280994F7264696E65FF0103><hex:02081FE1E93701FF176E656C6C65204669616D6D6520496D6D6F7274616C69FF0103>.

304.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_321
304.description: Expectations are high, and I think it's time we deployed the troops on a mission that truly tests the limits of their capabilities.
304.translation_description: Le aspettative sono alte e credo sia arrivato il momento di mandare i soldati in una missione che metta davvero alla prova le loro capacità.

308.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_400
308.description: Commander, the Adders' Nest has sent a new mission our way. I've read the briefing, and it's a tough one. But if we can pull it off... Well, let's just say I think we'll be in for a commendation.
308.translation_description: Comandante, il Nido delle Vipere ci ha affidato una nuova missione. Ho letto il briefing: sarà dura. Ma se riusciremo a portarla a termine... diciamo che potremmo ricevere un encomio.

309.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_401
309.description: By successfully completing command missions at five different locations, you have gained access to a special “flagged mission.”
309.translation_description: Completando con successo missioni di comando in cinque luoghi diversi, hai sbloccato una speciale «missione contrassegnata».

310.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SYSTEM_000_402
310.description: Due to the exceedingly high difficulty of this mission, however, it is advised that you first improve your squadron members' individual attributes as much as possible before attempting a deployment.
310.translation_description: La difficoltà di questa missione è estremamente elevata. Prima di affrontarla, ti consigliamo di migliorare quanto più possibile gli attributi individuali dei membri della squadriglia.

311.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_410
311.description: Congratulations, Commander! I knew our squadron was up to the task, but there's nothing quite so satisfying as seeing “Mission Successful” at the top of a report.
311.translation_description: Congratulazioni, Comandante! Sapevo che la squadriglia fosse all’altezza del compito, ma vedere «Missione completata con successo» in cima a un rapporto dà sempre una bella soddisfazione.

312.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_411
312.description: Seems we have a visitor...<hex:02100103>Come in!

313.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SWETHRYKBROOKSTONE_000_412
313.description: (-???-)I trust I've found the barracks of Lieutenant <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303> and <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> squadron?
313.translation_description: (-???-)Questa è la caserma del tenente <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303> e della <hex:02080DE905FF04737561FF0473756103> squadriglia, vero?

314.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_413
314.description: Serpent Marshal Brookstone! To what do we owe this honor?
314.translation_description: Maresciallo della Vipera Brookstone! A cosa dobbiamo quest’onore?

315.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SWETHRYKBROOKSTONE_000_414
315.description: I heard word the lieutenant had just returned from <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> mission, and I wished to speak with our decorated hero in person.
315.translation_description: Ho saputo che il tenente è appena rientrato dalla <hex:02080DE905FF04737561FF0473756103> missione e desideravo parlare di persona con il nostro eroe decorato.

316.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SWETHRYKBROOKSTONE_000_415
316.description: These are trying times, as you well know, but the valor shown by you and your troops is a source of inspiration for the entire company.
316.translation_description: Sono tempi difficili, come ben sai, ma il valore dimostrato da te e dalle tue truppe è fonte d’ispirazione per l’intera Grande Compagnia.

317.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_SWETHRYKBROOKSTONE_000_416
317.description: Taking your exemplary service into consideration, we've decided that a moment of recognition is long overdue. Ahem.
317.translation_description: Considerando il servizio esemplare che hai prestato, riteniamo che sia giunto il momento di renderti omaggio. Ehm...

319.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_418
319.description: What did I tell you! I knew a promotion was in the offing. And what an honor that our squadron's success merited a personal visit from the serpent marshal himself!
319.translation_description: Te l’avevo detto! Sapevo che una promozione era dietro l’angolo. E che onore: il successo della nostra squadriglia ha meritato una visita di persona da parte del maresciallo della Vipera!

320.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_000_419
320.description: Congratulations again, Commander. You've proven once again that with the right leadership, this squadron is capable of anything!
320.translation_description: Congratulazioni ancora, Comandante. Hai dimostrato un’altra volta che, con la guida giusta, questa squadriglia è capace di tutto!

321.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_400
321.description: Commander, the Maelstrom higher-ups have sent a new mission our way. I've read the briefing, and it's a tough one. But if we can pull it off... Well, let's just say I think we'll be in for a commendation.
321.translation_description: Comandante, i vertici della Tempesta ci hanno affidato una nuova missione. Ho letto il briefing: sarà dura. Ma se riusciremo a portarla a termine... diciamo che potremmo ricevere un encomio.

322.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_410
322.description: Congratulations, Commander! I knew our squadron was up to the task, but there's nothing quite so satisfying as seeing “Mission Successful” at the top of a report.
322.translation_description: Congratulazioni, Comandante! Sapevo che la squadriglia fosse all’altezza del compito, ma vedere «Missione completata con successo» in cima a un rapporto dà sempre una bella soddisfazione.

323.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_411
323.description: Seems we have a visitor...<hex:02100103>Come in!

324.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_100_412
324.description: (-???-)Greetings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I hope I'm not interrupting anything important.
324.translation_description: (-???-)Salve, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Spero di non interromperti in un momento importante.

325.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_413
325.description: Storm Marshal Slafyrsyn! To what do we owe this honor?
325.translation_description: Maresciallo della Tempesta Slafyrsyn! A cosa dobbiamo quest’onore?

326.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_100_414
326.description: I'd heard the lieutenant here had returned from <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> mission, and I wished to speak with <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> in person.
326.translation_description: Ho saputo che il tenente qui presente è appena rientrato dalla <hex:02080DE905FF04737561FF0473756103> missione e desideravo parlare con <hex:02080DE905FF046C6569FF046C756903> di persona.

327.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_100_415
327.description: As you well know, there is much to trouble a soldier's heart in these trying times. Yet the valor shown by you and your troops is a constant source of inspiration for many in the Maelstrom.
327.translation_description: Come ben sai, in questi tempi difficili c’è molto che può turbare il cuore di un soldato. Eppure il valore dimostrato da te e dalle tue truppe continua a ispirare molte persone nella Tempesta.

328.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_100_416
328.description: And after speaking with my colleagues, we've decided that a little recognition for your efforts is long overdue. A moment, if you will...
328.translation_description: Dopo averne parlato con i miei colleghi, abbiamo deciso che è giunto il momento di riconoscere i tuoi meriti. Un momento, se permetti...

330.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_418
330.description: What did I tell you! I knew a promotion was in the offing. And what an honor that our squadron's success merited a personal visit from the storm marshal himself!
330.translation_description: Te l’avevo detto! Sapevo che una promozione era dietro l’angolo. E che onore: il successo della nostra squadriglia ha meritato una visita di persona da parte del maresciallo della Tempesta!

331.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_100_419
331.description: Congratulations again, Commander. You've proven once again that with the right leadership, this squadron is capable of anything!
331.translation_description: Congratulazioni ancora, Comandante. Hai dimostrato un’altra volta che, con la guida giusta, questa squadriglia è capace di tutto!

332.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_400
332.description: Commander, the Hall of Flames has sent a new mission our way. I've read the briefing, and it's a tough one. But if we can pull it off... Well, let's just say I think we'll be in for a commendation.
332.translation_description: Comandante, la Sala delle Fiamme ci ha affidato una nuova missione. Ho letto il briefing: sarà dura. Ma se riusciremo a portarla a termine... diciamo che potremmo ricevere un encomio.

333.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_410
333.description: Congratulations, Commander! I knew our squadron was up to the task, but there's nothing quite so satisfying as seeing “Mission Successful” at the top of a report.
333.translation_description: Congratulazioni, Comandante! Sapevo che la squadriglia fosse all’altezza del compito, ma vedere «Missione completata con successo» in cima a un rapporto dà sempre una bella soddisfazione.

334.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_411
334.description: Seems we have a visitor...<hex:02100103>Come in!

335.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_STILLRIVER_200_412
335.description: (-???-)Lieutenant <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>? Good, I thought I'd wandered into the wrong barracks for a moment there.
335.translation_description: (-???-)Tenente <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>? Meno male, per un attimo ho creduto di trovarmi nella caserma sbagliata.

336.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_413
336.description: Flame Marshal River! To what do we owe this honor?
336.translation_description: Maresciallo della Fiamma River! A cosa dobbiamo quest’onore?

337.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_STILLRIVER_200_414
337.description: I'd heard the lieutenant here had returned from <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> mission, and wanted a word with <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> in person.
337.translation_description: Ho saputo che il tenente qui presente è appena rientrato dalla <hex:02080DE905FF04737561FF0473756103> missione e volevo parlare con <hex:02080DE905FF046C6569FF046C756903> di persona.

338.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_STILLRIVER_200_415
338.description: As you well know, the world's seen some tough times and there's more lurkin' up ahead. But you and your squadron, well, you've been the inspiration that many soldiers need to carry on.
338.translation_description: Come sai bene, il mondo ha attraversato tempi difficili e altri ci attendono più avanti. Però tu e la tua squadriglia siete stati una fonte d’ispirazione per tanti soldati, aiutandoli a trovare la forza di andare avanti.

339.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_STILLRIVER_200_416
339.description: I've gone over it with my peers in the Hall of Flames, and we reckon it's high time you were recognized for your efforts. A little quiet, if you will...
339.translation_description: Ne ho parlato con i miei colleghi della Sala delle Fiamme e riteniamo che sia giunto il momento di riconoscere i tuoi meriti. Silenzio, se permetti...

341.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_418
341.description: What did I tell you! I knew a promotion was in the offing. And what an honor that our squadron's success merited a personal visit from the flame marshal himself!
341.translation_description: Te l’avevo detto! Sapevo che una promozione era dietro l’angolo. E che onore: il successo della nostra squadriglia ha meritato una visita di persona da parte del maresciallo della Fiamma!

342.name: TEXT_COMARMGCARMYOFFICER_00342_PLATOONINSTRUCTOR_200_419
342.description: Congratulations again, Commander. You've proven once again that with the right leadership, this squadron is capable of anything!
342.translation_description: Congratulazioni ancora, Comandante. Hai dimostrato un’altra volta che, con la guida giusta, questa squadriglia è capace di tutto!
